## Problem And Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. For documentation, describe
what readers can now understand or do.

## Scope And Validation

Identify the affected interfaces, protocol or adapter boundaries, and documents.
List checks actually run and their results. State checks not run and remaining
limitations. Do not infer release or deployed verification from local checks.

## Compatibility And Security

Explain any effect on address rules, key binding, authorization, wire formats,
persistence, streaming, recovery, or identifying metadata. Use SECURITY.md
privately for undisclosed vulnerabilities.

## Contribution Ownership

Identify original contributions, third-party material, and relevant notices.
You retain copyright. Maintainers verify coverage under
CONTRIBUTOR_LICENSE_AGREEMENT.md before merging new original contributions.

A maintainer will provide the reviewed agreement revision for one-time acceptance
when needed. Filing this PR is not CLA acceptance; do not accept unreviewed draft
terms through a template checkbox.

- [ ] I reviewed the final change and removed private or identifying material.
- [ ] I preserved required copyright and license notices.
- [ ] My description distinguishes implemented behavior from planned work.
